decision_rules.fallback: Use the first nonblank source in the fixed order only when every earlier source is blank.
decision_rules.conflict: If any available sources contain different normalized nonblank categories, raw result is Conflict and model category is Not available.
decision_rules.binary: Only Positive and Negative are model-available. Indeterminate, Equivocal, Not Evaluated, Performed but Not Available, Conflict, blank, and every other category are Not available.
decision_rules.pam50: Availability only; never used as a Phase 15 model input.
